A personal training business runs on small numbers that slip away: sessions left on a package, a renewal nobody chased, a plateau nobody spotted, a coach paid for hours that never earned their cost back. They hide in chat threads and half-finished spreadsheets that never agree with each other.
This suite gives every desk of the business its own workbook, all connected by the same clients, coaches and packages — 231 pages in all, each specific to the job:

1. Clients and Memberships — every client's package with sessions left and days to expiry, renewals and the revenue at risk, arrears ageing, freezes with days owed, no-shows and late cancels, lead pipeline with cost per source, trial conversion by coach, referrals, consents and the waiting list.

2. Programmes and Progress — an injury-aware exercise library, programme blocks, a workout log that finds personal records and plateaus by itself, deload planning, weekly volume per muscle group, body measurements, fitness retests, goals with a predicted date, habit check-ins and challenges.

3. Money and Coaches — income ledger with tax and margin, invoices and receivables ageing, deferred revenue for unused sessions, coach pay with utilisation, margin per package, profit and lifetime value per client, sales tax or VAT by month and a 12-week cash forecast.

4. Studio and Schedule — weekly timetable with live slot status, fill by hour and weekday, coach load and leave cover, late cancel policy, class attendance, equipment service dates, stock reorder, cleaning checklists, incident and first aid logs, closures and weather.

Inside: 48 calculators, 60 printable forms and documents (agreements, receipts, progress reports) filled from your records, 107 ready WhatsApp messages, 32 checklists and 71 live charts with 119 dashboard figures.
Type in the white cells; everything grey calculates by itself. Each workbook comes with an English copy full of realistic sample data, so you can see every page working before you enter your own.

15 languages in one purchase: English, Arabic, French, Spanish, German, Italian, Portuguese, Turkish, Dutch, Russian, Persian, Urdu, Hindi, Chinese and Indonesian (Arabic, Persian and Urdu read right to left). Standard .xlsx files for Microsoft Excel and LibreOffice. No macros, no subscription, one payment, instant download. Licence for one business.

Do I need special software?
No. The files open in Microsoft Excel on Windows or Mac and in LibreOffice Calc, which is free.
Does it suit one coach and a studio with several coaches?
Yes. The coach columns work for one coach or many; the sample data shows a studio with five coaches.
Can I replace the sample data with my own?
Yes. Clear the sample rows and type or paste yours; lists, formulas, alerts, dashboards and calculators update by themselves.
Are the calculators medical or tax advice?
No. Calorie, heart rate and tax calculators are planning aids that use your own settings; they do not replace a doctor, dietitian or accountant.
Where do I start?
Open the workbook in your language, fill the yellow cells on the Start sheet, then follow the How to use it steps.
Are there macros or a subscription?
No macros and no add-ins: only formulas, so the files are safe to open. One payment, instant download.
